column1: # V29 native-word spelling targets (non-loanword Bangla). Checked by V29NativeTest on the voice token path:
# the recorded shipped converter output goes through main's LoanSpell.token + nfc exit and is compared with the canonical spelling.
#  status main         = main fixes it; must match (hard).
#  status open         = wrong today and fixable in main; expected to fail (xfail). A pass is reported as XPASS and fails the rig: promote it to main.
#  status needs-source = the defect is in Tier1/ScriptFix, which main does not carry (dex only); xfail. XPASS also fails the rig.
#  status keep         = a precision guard: main must return the shipped output unchanged (hard).
# Canonical spellings: standard Bangla (Bangla Academy) forms, NFC as the voice exit emits them. 'shipped' = V29.3 voice output recorded in the source column.
